verdict.rationale: Name.com documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents such as Cursor and Claude Desktop call Core API operations on the user's behalf. Natural-language commands in those clients can therefore drive real domain, DNS and transfer actions. An agent skill file covering domain settings, a read-only docs MCP server and an llms.txt index add to this. Missing for 10: a native natural-language interface (it relies on third-party agent clients), documentation of which operations the MCP server covers, and any independent or hands-on evidence that natural-language operation works in practice.
